segments.text: Let's turn today to Acts of the Apostles, Chapter 20 and verse 25.

them to the town of Miletus to give them some closing exhortations before he left for
Jerusalem.

them the example of his own life.
He says, All the time I was with you, you have seen how I lived in your midst in humility
and love and working hard and sharing the gospel of God's grace and didn't hide anything
profitable for you, suffering persecution, not valuing my own life.
I only want to finish my course, he says in the previous verses, verses 19 to 18 to 24.

preaching the kingdom will see my face no more.
What did Paul preach?

the good news of the grace of God.

power to forgive us and also to give us victory over sin.

rule over people preaching the kingdom.

people in Ephesus.

Notice the context.

not because I told you that Jesus died for your sins, but because I have declared to
you the whole purpose, the whole counsel of God.

purpose.

whole purpose of God.
Notice that very clearly.
I am free from the blood of all men because I did not shrink from declaring to you the
whole purpose of God.

In verse 21 it consists of the message of God's grace that is sufficient for every need.

life where Jesus Christ is not only Savior but Lord of our life.

When we have declared the whole purpose of God, then we are free from people's blood,

So he says, I want to testify to you that I spent all these three years declaring to
you the whole purpose of God, and I am free from all of your blood.
Now it's up to you to decide whether you want to obey what I have told you.
